wrap_4_char_gap.status: NOT a bug to fix by giving the TUI more columns. Documented in _measure.
wrap_4_char_gap.visible: Grok/Claude wrap ~4 cells before the ST view edge (black strip, then minimap).
wrap_4_char_gap.why_the_tax_exists: Smaller tax -> ST H-scrollbar appears -> viewport_extent changes -> watcher reports new cols to the PTY (SIGWINCH).
wrap_4_char_gap.claude_no_alt_screen: A width SIGWINCH makes Claude (force_main_screen) rewrap/replay the whole visible conversation (~1000 lines). That replay changes layout, reports width again, repeats ~10 times.
wrap_4_char_gap.live_2026-08-15: User resized the tab. Scrolling back, the conversation is wrapped to the NEW size. No H-scrollbar because of the 4-char tax. They stated: if we reduce the tax, the H-bar WILL appear after that rewrap. So the gap is not only 'startup oscillation' -- it is required after every legitimate resize+rewrap as long as ST charges ~3 extra layout cells.
wrap_4_char_gap.real_fix: Stop ST from adding those extra layout cells, or hide the H-bar, THEN we can report a view-filling width. The TUI will rewrap to it and still not get a bar. Do not send more columns while ST still charges +3.
wrap_4_char_gap.do_not: Do not reduce 4.0 as the fix. Do not report a wider PTY size. Do not use word_wrap=True (extra visual row -> V-scrollbar).
